paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Expert win rates 0.90\% in EBS feedback judgment. Our annotations achieve an average win rate of 88.890.90\%. All 12 LLMs exceed an 820.90\% rate in preferring our EBS.

model_annotations.English: The bar chart displays the expert win rates (in percentage) for 12 large language models (LLMs) in an evaluation based on EBS feedback judgment, where the expert annotations achieved an average win rate of 88.89%. The horizontal axis lists the names of the LLMs in a specific order: GPT-4o, GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o-mini, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3.1-405B, Mistral Large, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen-Max, and GLM-4-Plus. The vertical axis represents the “Expert Win Rate (%)”, scaled from 0 to 100 in increments of 20. Each bar corresponds to one LLM and is colored distinctly; the bar heights reflect the win rates, with values labeled directly above each bar. The highest win rate is observed for GLM-4-Plus at 92.54%, followed by Mistral Large at 97.14% and GPT-4o-mini at 97.56%. The lowest win rate among the models is Qwen-Max at 82.26%, with all other models exceeding 83% and all 12 models surpassing 82%, consistent with the caption’s claim. The bars appear sorted roughly in descending order of win rates, except for a few inversions (e.g., GPT-4o-mini is higher than Mistral Large despite its position). The chart includes a red diagonal label “Average” pointing to the first bar (GPT-4o), visually anchoring the expert average of 88.89%. No stacked or grouped bars are present, and there is no legend, implying color is used only for visual distinction.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates the expert win rates (in percentage) for 12 large language models (LLMs) in an EBS feedback judgment task, where human experts evaluated model-generated summaries against a baseline. The horizontal axis lists the LLMs in the following order: GPT-4o, GPT-4-turbo, Claude 3.5-mini, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3.1-405B, Mistral Large, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen-Max, and GLM-4-Plus. The vertical axis represents the "Expert Win Rate (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. Each bar corresponds to one LLM and is color-coded for visual distinction; the values are labeled directly on top of each bar. The win rates range from 82.26% (Qwen-Max) to 97.56% (Claude 3.5-mini), with the average win rate across all models being 88.89%, as noted in the caption. All 12 models exceed 82% win rate, indicating strong preference for the EBS summaries over the alternatives in expert judgment. The bars are arranged left to right in the order listed, without explicit sorting by value, and no visual emphasis (e.g., highlighting or annotations) is applied to any specific bar.
